calls.title: Growthbook Check-in
calls.summary: The team outlined a six-week Proof of Concept (PoC) aimed at implementing feature flags, conducting experimentation, and enhancing product analytics. The PoC is expected to start soon and will use a dedicated instance of GrowthBook for better visibility and support. Participants discussed the need for clear communication and coordination, proposing a dedicated Slack channel to streamline interactions. Additionally, the meeting addressed scalability concerns, data handling for experiments, and the ongoing support provided under the active enterprise agreement. The transition from a self-hosted to a cloud-based solution was a key consideration to enable better functionality and monitoring during the PoC.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, GrowthBook, enterprise PoC, scalability, data integration
